items.summary: A Bloom filter is a probabilistic data structure used to test whether an item is in a set. It provides a fast and efficient way to determine whether an item is likely to be in a set, with a low false positive rate.

items.title: Monotonic Reads - How Asynchronous Replication Creates Wormholes
items.summary: Asynchronous replication creates wormholes in a distributed datastore by allowing reads to hit different replicas with different replication lags, causing oscillations between old and new values.

items.title: When to Change Jobs - The 3P Framework
items.summary: When to change jobs involves assessing three key factors: whether your current role challenges you, introduces new technologies, and contributes to professional depth and breadth; whether monetary compensation is a primary motivator; and whether you have a clear path for promotion and responsibility. If two or more of these factors outweigh the lack of core competency, it may be time to consider a change. A simple 3P framework can help guide career decisions.
